name: Salvatore Esposito
bio: Salvatore Esposito is an Italian actor. He is best known for his leading role as Gennaro "Genny" Savastano on the Sky Italia television series Gomorrah (2014–2021). In 2020, Esposito made his English-language debut by appearing in the 4th season of the American TV series Fargo.
